preserves: cfg_b, cfg_c and cfg_d results and hashes stay. This file adds a step guard and two explicit trim caps. Development seeds through 276383 are not reused. The 15 deg/s 90 degree shorts still fail on this law, so they are not in this preregistration. Slalom seed 271181 still falls, so slalom is not in this preregistration. Fast stride had a 26 deg yaw in a 48-seed screen, so it is not in this preregistration.
restart_pass: Upright. Speed 6.2-7.6 s below 0.03 m/s. Speed 9.5-11.5 s above 0.08 m/s. |final yaw| <= 15 deg. The second rise waits for the next double-support edge at or after 8 s. During that later cycle the yaw trim cap is 0.04 rad. The first walk keeps 0.02 rad.
straight_pass: Upright, |final yaw| <= 15 deg, progress >= 0.08 m/s. Regression only. No heading, no restart, no stride scale.

bounds_if_nominal_perfect.note: Run only if restart is 1000/1000. A 100-seed Wilson lower near 96% is not a 99.5% mass claim.

criterion: The n=1000 restart block needs its own Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.995. Not pooled with any other command, direction, head, or hash.
